purpose: Frozen independent expectations for T4-U4a (DEL-04-07 Design/arc-frames-and-signs.md): the end rows of realized arcs in the tangent frame at each end, node-on-element, on preview-physics-1 and pressure-1; the unchanged cut rows; and wrong-frame and wrong-sign discriminators.
basis: u4a_engine.py: unit-load (flexibility) method, 90-digit decimal, closed-form statics, 48-point Gauss-Legendre virtual-work integrals; imports no product code
numbers: Invented test quantities. Not material-library, component-library or code-rule data.
inputs: node coordinates, y_reference components and load components are the binary64 values written in requests.json and are used as exact inputs; section, material, radius, k, pressure and temperature are exact decimal targets

conventions.chord_frame: x = (x_j - x_i)/L, y = y_reference projected normal to x and normalised (the bow direction), z = x cross y
conventions.tangent_frame: at arc angle psi from authored node i: x = arc tangent toward authored j, y = toward the arc centre, z = bend-plane normal (x_i - c) cross (x_j - c), normalised; on a straight, the element-local frame
conventions.cuts: j-side section action at the station in the frame at that station (positive N is tension); pressure-1 gives N_w (wall) and S = N_w - p Ai
conventions.end_rows: node-on-element elastic action: end_i = -(elastic cut at fraction 0), end_j = +(elastic cut at fraction 1), in the tangent frame at that end; chord_frame is the same vector in the chord frame (today's arc end rows)
conventions.chord_to_tangent_rotation: rows are the tangent axes at that end in chord components: end_i [[c, s, 0], [s, -c, 0], [0, 0, -1]], end_j [[c, -s, 0], [-s, -c, 0], [0, 0, -1]], s = L/(2R), c = sqrt(1 - s^2)
conventions.wall_end_action: pressure-1: node-on-element wall action along the end tangent, end_i = -N_w(0), end_j = +N_w(1)
conventions.stresses: SI (Pa): sigma_axial = N/As (preview-physics-1) or sigma_m_wall_membrane = N_w/As (pressure-1); sigma_b_y = M_y/Z; sigma_b_z = M_z/Z; tau_t = T r_o/J
conventions.supports: support-on-pipe, global; moment about the attached node

criterion.rule: |observed - expected| <= 1e-9 * max(|expected|, zero_scale(member, family)) per row, in both solver modes
criterion.zero_scale: per member: force = max |N|, |S|, |V_y|, |V_z| over its five cuts; moment = max |T|, |M_y|, |M_z| over its five cuts (the case maximum if the member's is zero); displacements and supports use 1e-9 * max(|expected|, the case's maximum of that family)
criterion.unit_transforms: the oracle is SI; the product publishes translations in mm and element stresses in MPa: compare after exact conversion
criterion.discriminators: each wrong frame or sign must be at least 1e3 tolerances from the oracle on at least one published arc end row of the case; listed_rows give up to six such rows

objectivity_controls.note: differences are the binary64 rounding of the rotated inputs, which the oracle takes as exact
